Definition: Jericho or Jerecho, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Jericho is a place in Palestine, the first city Israel took in the land. In Numbers 22:1, pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: Jericho is the first city Israel takes, and I hold that its walls falling is the sign God gives His people.
